EmailTemplate.subject: OPRT - Conditional Field Styles
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for your email. Insperity Organizational Planning offers the ability to set conditions for field styles and data blocks so data within employee boxes can be highlighted or emphasized.
You can view our job aid here for assistance with setting up field conditions. If you have any additional questions or if I can be of further assistance, please let me know.
Thank you,
